QuestInfo.name: Specter Invasion
QuestInfo.0: A defense force has been organized, but it isn't strong enough to resist Magnus's attack. The only way to get through this is to hold out until the Protective Shield is restored. Seems like the patrol has some news. Go see #p3000000#.
QuestInfo.1: The main Specter force has launched their attack! Stop their attack at the eastern boundary by\r\n#bdefeating all weakened Specter Shield Soldiers and Weakened Warrior Specters#k. Can you do it?\n#rIf you fail the quest, you can forfeit it and start again.#k
QuestInfo.2: Wait, that was it! Is that all Magnus has?

yes.0: I wonder...is this really all Magnus has to throw at us? They conquered Heliseum, and can't muster a stronger force than this?
